figure.purpose: The headline number inside the ink block; the only text above 15 px.

percent.purpose: The percentage on each provider card, right-aligned, tabular.

title.purpose: Provider names, section titles and page titles.

body.purpose: Descriptions, notes, hints and settings text.

label.purpose: Field labels, metric captions, pills and segmented options.

status.purpose: Uppercase LIVE / ACTIVE / LOCAL labels beside their dot.

mono.purpose: Paths, commands and identifiers only; never numbers.

shadows.name: sheet-light
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: lifts sheets and the active segment in light mode. Dark mode uses hairlines alone.

motion.name: bar-fill
motion.purpose: Usage bars and the ink-block bar growing to a new value.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: Refresh and busy icons only; disabled under reduced motion.

components.css: .ds-ink { font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 320px; padding: 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--qp-block-bg, #111111); color: var(--qp-block-text, #F4F3EF); } .ds-ink-head, .ds-ink-body, .ds-ink-meta { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-ink-head > span:first-child, .ds-ink-meta { font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--qp-block-muted, #A9A69E); } .ds-ink-meta { font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ink-live { display: inline-flex; gap: 5px; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-block-rail, rgb(244 243 239 / 0.18)); font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ink-live i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: #5CC28A; } .ds-ink-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-ink-fig { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ink-bar { height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-block-rail, rgb(244 243 239 / 0.18)); overflow: hidden; } .ds-ink-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: #E0A040; }

components.css: .ds-pcard { font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 320px; padding: 14px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--qp-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--qp-border, #E4E1DA); box-shadow: var(--qp-shadow, 0 1px 2px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.04)); color: var(--qp-text, #111111); } .ds-pcard:hover { border-color: var(--qp-border-strong, #CFCBC2); } .ds-pcard-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-mono { width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 999px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--qp-border, #E4E1DA); background: var(--qp-surface-2, #FAF9F6); } .ds-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; flex: 1; } .ds-pct { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-sub { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--qp-muted, #6F6C64); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-bar { height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-rail, #ECEAE4); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-ink, #111111); } .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--qp-live, #23784A); } .ds-status i { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Usage Bar
components.description: 4 px ink line on a rail. Ink below 70 %, ochre 70–89 %, red at 90 % and above, Estimate Grey for estimates (with ~).
components.css: .ds-bars { display: grid; gap: 10px; width: 240px; } .ds-ub { height: 4px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-rail, #ECEAE4); overflow: hidden; } .ds-ub span { display: block; height: 100%; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-ink, #111111); } .ds-ub .w { background: var(--qp-warn, #A15C00); } .ds-ub .d { background: var(--qp-danger, #B42318); } .ds-ub .e { background: var(--qp-estimate, #A8A59D); }

components.name: Segmented Pills
components.description: Rail track with a 2 px inset; the active option is a sheet chip with a hairline.
components.css: .ds-seg { font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-rail, #ECEAE4); } .ds-seg button { min-height: 22px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--qp-text-2, #4A4843); font: 600 10.5px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button.on { background: var(--qp-surface, #FFFFFF); border-color: var(--qp-border, #E4E1DA); color: var(--qp-text, #111111); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(17 17 17 / 0.04); }

components.name: Navigation Pills
components.description: Icon pills; the active page is a solid ink pill with a chalk icon, inactive pills show a rail on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav span { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--qp-text-2, #4A4843); } .ds-nav span:hover { background: var(--qp-rail, #ECEAE4); } .ds-nav span.on { background: var(--qp-ink, #111111); color: var(--qp-on-ink, #F4F3EF); }

components.name: Hint Box + Action
components.description: Paper-soft inset with an ochre left rule; the fix-it action is an ink pill button.
components.html: La sesión de Claude terminó. Vuelve a iniciar sesión para ver la cuota en vivo.
components.css: .ds-hint { font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; display: grid; gap: 8px; width: 300px; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid var(--qp-border, #E4E1DA); border-left: 2px solid var(--qp-warn, #A15C00); background: var(--qp-surface-2, #FAF9F6); color: var(--qp-text-2, #4A4843); font-size: 11.5px; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-hint button { justify-self: start; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--qp-ink, #111111); background: var(--qp-ink, #111111); color: var(--qp-on-ink, #F4F3EF); font: 600 11.5px Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-hint button:hover { background: var(--qp-ink-hover, #000000); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: On/off switch: ink track when on, rail when off.
components.css: .ds-sw { font-family: Manrope, 'Segoe UI Variable', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--qp-text-2, #4A4843); font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-sw i { position: relative; width: 28px; height: 16px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-ink, #111111); } .ds-sw b { position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 14px; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--qp-on-ink, #F4F3EF); }

narrative.overview:
QuotaPulse reads like a well-set printed report that happens to update itself. The ground is warm paper, cards are crisp white sheets with a hairline edge, and the one figure that matters most right now is printed in a solid ink block. Everything else is black ink at three strengths. Numbers are set in tabular figures and aligned like a ledger; progress is a thin ink line on a soft rail; filters are pills you can feel the edge of.

The register is editorial, clean, tactile and high-contrast: no glass, no glow, no gradient, no tinted blue-grey. Colour is almost absent, so when ochre or red appears on a bar it is unmistakably a warning. Dark mode is the same report printed in chalk on charcoal: neutral, never blue, never neon.

Density is that of a tray widget. Everything must read at 360 px wide; a wider window gains columns, not bigger type.

Confirmed rejections: generic AI-dashboard looks (gradients, glows, frosted glass, oversized diffuse shadows, blue-tinted greys), fake 0 % bars or percentages when no real figure exists, and decoration that carries no information.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, white sheet cards, 1 px hairlines, almost no shadow.
One ink block per view for the headline figure.
Ink is the only colour for data; ochre and red only for threshold warnings, green only for the LIVE dot.
4 px progress lines with right-aligned tabular percentages.
Segmented pills with a high-contrast active state.
One custom 1.5 px stroke icon set and geometric provider monograms.

rules.name: The Ink Is Data Rule
rules.body: Below 70 % a bar is plain ink. Colour on a bar means a threshold was crossed and nothing else; providers are never colour-coded.

rules.name: The One Block Rule
rules.body: At most one ink block per view. It holds the single most important real figure (the live window closest to its limit). With no live figure it holds a plain-language status, never a placeholder number.

rules.name: The Estimate Wears Grey Rule
rules.body: An approximate figure is shown with a `~` prefix and an Estimate Grey fill, never ink and never a status colour.

rules.name: The Tabular Truth Rule
rules.body: Every number that can change (percent, tokens, cost, countdown, reset time) uses `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` so nothing jitters on update.

rules.name: The Figures Speak Rule
rules.body: Size is reserved for numbers. Words never go above 13 px; hierarchy among words comes from weight and ink strength.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs a shadow larger than 2 px to be seen, the value step is wrong; fix the colour, not the shadow.

dos: Do keep data in ink; let ochre and red appear only when a threshold is crossed.
Do put the single most important live figure in the one ink block.
Do use tabular figures for every changing number and right-align percentages.
Do design at 360 px first, truncating labels before numbers.
Do draw every icon from the custom 1.5 px set and every provider with its monogram.
donts: Don't show a bar, a 0 % or a computed percentage when no real figure exists; write a plain-language note instead.
Don't use gradients, glows, neon, glass, backdrop blur or shadows larger than 2 px.
Don't use blue-tinted greys anywhere; every neutral is warm (light) or neutral charcoal (dark).
Don't colour-code providers or put more than one ink block in a view.
Don't import an icon library or use the providers' official logos inside the interface.
Don't let any element cause horizontal page scroll at 360 px.
